name: plan-ledger
description: Work-plan tracker: the orchestrator hands items to subagents by reference; the agent claims done and the mod verifies.

registerTool.title: Register the plan tool
registerTool.description: Off: the plan tool is not registered, so no agent can read or change a plan through it; the /plans command stays. Only an exact false turns it off. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session.

attemptCap.title: Attempts per item
attemptCap.description: How many times an item may be claimed before it stays failed until the orchestrator reopens it. Whole number, 1 to 10.

injectMaxChars.title: Plan status size
injectMaxChars.description: Most characters of plan status handed to the orchestrator at session start, after /clear and after /compact (about 4 characters per token). Whole number, 100 to 4000.
